# Set Up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
 
Packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "stats", "ggfortify", "ggrepel", "svglite", "pheatmap")

lapply(Packages, library, character.only=TRUE)
```

```{r source_function, include=FALSE}
#Source Functions
source("functions.R")
source("missingness_visualization_functions.R")
```

```{r set_path, include=FALSE}
png_path <- "../../results/untargeted/batch2_clean"
svg_path <- "../../results/untargeted/batch2_clean/svg"
csv_path <- "../../results/untargeted/batch2_clean/csv"
```

## Load Dataset(s)

```{r LoadDataset, include=FALSE}
#Peak Area Values
batch2_peak_area = read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_peak_area_values.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)

#Metabolite Annotations
batch2_compound_annotation = read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_metabolite_annotations.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)

#Sample Metadata
batch2_sample_metadata = read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_sample_metadata.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r log_transform, include=FALSE}
# Create a log10-transformed copy for abundance calculations
# batch2_peak_area stays raw so prepare_long_data can handle its own log transform
# log10(x + 1) pseudocount handles any zeros
sample_cols_idx <- grep("^Sample", names(batch2_peak_area), value = FALSE)

batch2_peak_area_log <- batch2_peak_area
batch2_peak_area_log[, sample_cols_idx] <- lapply(
  batch2_peak_area[, sample_cols_idx],
  function(x) log10(as.numeric(x) + 1)
)

cat("Log10-transformed copy created: batch2_peak_area_log\n")
cat("Intensity range after transform:",
    range(unlist(batch2_peak_area_log[, sample_cols_idx]), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## Annotation Completeness
```{r annotation_completeness}
# Define annotation categories to check
annotation_categories <- c("Super.Class", "Class", "Sub.Class", "Pathways")

# Calculate missingness per category for annotated metabolites only
annotation_completeness <- batch2_compound_annotation %>%
  filter(Compound.ID %in% batch2_peak_area$Compound.ID) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(annotation_categories),
                   list(
                     n_missing  = ~sum(is.na(.) | . == ""),
                     n_present  = ~sum(!is.na(.) & . != ""),
                     pct_missing = ~round(100 * mean(is.na(.) | . == ""), 1)
                   ),
                   .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to  = c("Category", ".value"),
               names_sep = "__") %>%
  mutate(Total = n_missing + n_present,
         Category = factor(Category, levels = annotation_categories))

# Print summary table
cat("\n=== ANNOTATION COMPLETENESS SUMMARY ===\n")
print(annotation_completeness %>%
        dplyr::select(Category, n_present, n_missing, Total, pct_missing) %>%
        rename("Annotated" = n_present, "Missing" = n_missing,
               "% Missing" = pct_missing))

# Stacked bar: annotated vs missing per category
annotation_completeness_long <- annotation_completeness %>%
  dplyr::select(Category, n_present, n_missing) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(n_present, n_missing),
               names_to  = "Status",
               values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Status = recode(Status,
                         "n_present" = "Annotated",
                         "n_missing" = "Missing"))

p_annotation_completeness <- ggplot(annotation_completeness_long,
                                    aes(x = Category, y = Count, fill = Status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Annotated" = "#2E86AB", "Missing" = "#E84855")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "batch2 clean Annotation Completeness by Category",
       x = "Annotation Category",
       y = "Number of Metabolites",
       fill = "Status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(p_annotation_completeness, "batch2 clean annotation_completeness",
                 png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(p_annotation_completeness)

# Percent-missing bar for a cleaner at-a-glance view
p_annotation_pct_missing <- ggplot(annotation_completeness,
                                   aes(x = Category, y = pct_missing, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_missing, "%")),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "batch2 clean % Metabolites Missing Annotation by Category",
       x = "Annotation Category",
       y = "% Missing") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(p_annotation_pct_missing, "batch2 clean annotation_pct_missing",
                 png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(p_annotation_pct_missing)
```

## PCA

```{r PCA_One, echo = TRUE}
# PCA of sample variation
# Prepare data for PCA (samples as rows, metabolites as columns)
# Uses log10-transformed data with 1/5th min imputation for PCA only
samples_matrix <- batch2_peak_area_log %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Sample")) %>%
  t()

# 1/5th min value imputation for remaining NAs
samples_matrix <- apply(samples_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

# Perform PCA
pca_samples <- prcomp(samples_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Convert PCA results to data frame and add Sample labels
sample_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_samples$x)
sample_scores$Sample <- rownames(sample_scores)

# Merge sample scores with metadata
sample_scores <- sample_scores %>%
  left_join(batch2_sample_metadata, by = "Sample")

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained_samples <- pca_samples$sdev^2 / sum(pca_samples$sdev^2) * 100

# Create Elbow Plot
elbow_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained_samples),
  VarExp = var_explained_samples
)

sample_elbow <- ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = PC, y = VarExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCA Variance Explained by Samples") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_elbow, "sample_elbow", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(sample_elbow)

# Plot PCA for samples
sample_pca <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Sample), size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]), 
       title = "PCA of Sample Variation")

save_dual_format(sample_pca, "sample_pca", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(sample_pca)

# Sex PCA
sample_pca1x2_sex <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Sex, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#FF69B4", "M" = "#4169E1")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca1x2_sex, "sample_pca1x2_sex", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(sample_pca1x2_sex)

sample_pca2x3_sex <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = Sex, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[3]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Sex") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#FF69B4", "M" = "#4169E1")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca2x3_sex, "sample_pca2x3_sex", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(sample_pca2x3_sex)

# GW PCA
sample_pca1x2_gw <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = GW, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Gestational Week") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca1x2_gw, "sample_pca1x2_gw", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(sample_pca1x2_gw)

sample_pca2x3_gw <- ggplot(sample_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3, color = GW, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_samples[3]),
       title = "Sample PCA by Gestational Week") +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(sample_pca2x3_gw, "sample_pca2x3_gw", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(sample_pca2x3_gw)

# PCA of metabolite variation
# Prepare data for PCA (metabolites as rows, samples as columns)
metabolites_matrix <- batch2_peak_area_log %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Sample"))

metabolites_matrix <- apply(metabolites_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

# Perform PCA
pca_metabolites <- prcomp(metabolites_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

# Filter annotation to only include compounds present in peak area
compounds_in_peak <- unique(batch2_peak_area$Compound.ID)

batch2_compound_annotation <- batch2_compound_annotation %>%
  filter(Compound.ID %in% compounds_in_peak)

# Convert PCA results to data frame and add metabolite labels
metabolite_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_metabolites$x)
metabolite_scores$Name <- batch2_compound_annotation$Name

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained_metabolites <- pca_metabolites$sdev^2 / sum(pca_metabolites$sdev^2) * 100

# Create Elbow Plot
elbow_data <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(var_explained_metabolites),
  VarExp = var_explained_metabolites
)

metabolite_elbow <- ggplot(elbow_data, aes(x = PC, y = VarExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Variance Explained (%)",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCA Variance Explained by Metabolites") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(metabolite_elbow, "metabolite_elbow", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(metabolite_elbow)

# Calculate distance from origin for each metabolite
metabolite_scores <- metabolite_scores %>%
  mutate(distance = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2))

# Define a threshold for labeling outliers
threshold <- quantile(metabolite_scores$distance, 0.99)

# Create a logical column to indicate if the metabolite is an outlier
metabolite_scores <- metabolite_scores %>%
  mutate(is_outlier = distance > threshold)

# Plot PCA for metabolites with outlier labels
metabolite_pca1x2 <- ggplot(metabolite_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is_outlier, Name, "")), vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[2]), 
       title = "PCA of Metabolite Variation") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(metabolite_pca1x2, "metabolite_pca1x2", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(metabolite_pca1x2)

metabolite_pca2x3 <- ggplot(metabolite_scores, aes(x = PC2, y = PC3)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is_outlier, Name, "")), vjust = -1, hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[2]),
       y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_metabolites[3]), 
       title = "PCA of Metabolite Variation") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

save_dual_format(metabolite_pca2x3, "metabolite_pca2x3", png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
print(metabolite_pca2x3)
```
